Name: Vanillin Farmland Fields
Author: IVanillinI
Description:
[left][size=3][color=#bf9000][b]Have you always lacked space on your farm? Have you ever wanted to have features of other vanilla farms?
Wanted to have the best separate multiplayer experience? Welcome to Vanillin Farmland Fields!
This is a huge farm with almost all the features of other vanilla farms!
This is one of the largest and most detailed farms in the nexus![/b][/color]

[color=#bf9000][i]A huge area for all your ideas!
Share the farm with friends or play alone on these huge fields
Almost every tile can be dig up with a hoe
Sometimes forage and weeds with mixed seeds will appear on the farm
At the start, you will receive 6 Mixed Seeds, 15 Field Snack, 5 Joja Cola, 1 Chest
(for a more complex and balanced experience)
[/i][i]The farm has some minecarts and rowboats for quick movement around the farm
Initially, some areas and bridges are blocked by boulders, stumps, logs
You will need upgraded tools to customize the farm for yourself.[/i][/color]

[color=#93c47d][i]The farm is very rich in grass, stones and wood and other natural benefits
There is a huge forest on the farm with renewable stumps, forage,
blue grass, berry bushes and weeds with mixed seed.
You can get there through a passage in a cave on the farm (sign with a pickaxe).[/i][/color]

[i][color=#d8d8d8]To the west of the entrance to the farm forest is a quarry where various types of stones and ores will spawn.[/color][/i]

[i][color=#6fa8dc]In the south you will find small sandy islands on which sometimes with supplie crate will be carried out[/color]
[color=#6fa8dc]In any water on the farm you can catch lake and river fish[/color]

[color=#8e7cc3]Monsters may appear in the future update
(Can you use vanilla setting when creating a farm?..)[/color]

In the east Farm Forest there is an entrance to a deep cave
It is implemented as an addon
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38255][color=#ffff00]Vanillin Deep Mines[/color][/url]﻿﻿

[/i][/size][i][color=#00ffff]FAQ:[/color]
[color=#00ffff]- Is this a replacement for the Standard Farm?[/color]
[color=#00ffff]- Updated to 1.4.0[/color]
[color=#00ffff]Now it is a new farm.[/color]

[color=#00ffff]- Is it possible to turn off fences on a farm?[/color]
[color=#00ffff]- Yes, GMCM allows you to customize the fences you need on your farm.[/color]

[color=#00ffff]- Will there be farm recolors?[/color]
[color=#00ffff]- Currently, there is support for[/color]
[color=#ffff00][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255][color=#ffff00]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/color][/url]﻿﻿﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085][color=#ffff00]Starblue Valley[/color][/url]﻿
[/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10635][color=#ffff00]Blue Grass Recolor[/color][/url]﻿
[color=#00ffff]In the future, I may add support for other recolors.[/color]



[/i][/left]

Added support for Blue Grass Recolor
World map fixes
